note: H107: Adversarial Soundness Audit of Autoloop Evaluators, G35 Rule Selection, and W7 Witness Transitions

controls.name: C1_evaluator_defect_detected
controls.must_fire_because: auditor must detect key mismatch defects in eval_graph_ai and eval_verification
controls.can_fail_because: if evaluator keys were modified or masked
controls.null_must_contain: evaluators passing without detecting key mismatches

controls.name: C2_hub_bias_measured
controls.must_fire_because: auditor must measure that >50% of constant grounding rules concentrate on top-500 hubs
controls.can_fail_because: if dataset partitioning or entity counting failed
controls.null_must_contain: constant rules uniformly distributed across all 14,505 entities

controls.name: C3_w7_fork_injection_reproduced
controls.must_fire_because: auditor must reproduce that unbound delta_n splits sequence chain head on identical state roots
controls.can_fail_because: if delta_n binding check was already implemented
controls.null_must_contain: apply_epoch rejecting mismatched delta_n or failing to split chain heads

falsifiers.name: F1_system_soundness_hypothesis
falsifiers.can_fail_because: all three candidate components resist adversarial attack (no evaluator defects, no hub bias, no fork injection)
falsifiers.null_must_contain: all attacks failing to find soundness defects
falsifiers.refutes: the hypothesis that Autoloop evaluators, G35 rule selection, and W7 state transitions are cryptographically and empirically sound
falsifiers.fires_when: all three candidate components resist adversarial attack (no evaluator defects, no hub bias, no fork injection)
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire
